title: Childcare Registration Form
subtitle: An original operational registration for childcare registration that connects identity, evidence, authority, exceptions, privacy, and accountable closeout.
description: This Childcare Registration Form supports the complete childcare registration workflow from intake and routing through evidence, authorized decisions, exception ownership, qualified review, and final handoff.
use_case: Use the Childcare Registration Form when the assigned childcare enrollment lead needs one fillable record for child enrollment, daily care routing, authorized release, and onboarding without inventing legal, medical, safety, consent, certification, or professional authority.

sections.title: Childcare registration identity and routing
sections.guidance: Connect this registration to one child enrollment, daily care routing, authorized release, and onboarding record, an accountable owner, and the current review route.

blocks.label: Childcare record reference
blocks.guidance: Use the approved roster or case reference rather than creating a second identity.

blocks.label: Participant and responsible route
blocks.guidance: Record references and routing information only; keep sensitive details in approved systems.

blocks.label: Childcare scope, trigger, prior handoff, and known limitations

fields.label: Scope, trigger, prior handoff, and known limitations

sections.title: Childcare registration intake and requested placement
sections.guidance: Capture one requested program assignment, schedule, and accountable enrollment route.

blocks.label: Childcare registration information
items: Requested program, room, days, and attendance window
Child identity and preferred name or roster reference
Guardian and alternate emergency contact routing
Authorized pickup names or verification record location
Meal, allergy, medication, and health-plan reference
Accessibility, communication, sensory, or behavioral support route
Daily arrival, transition, rest, and departure information
Orientation, supplies, start conditions, and enrollment owner

blocks.label: Schedule, arrival, departure, routing, and owner
Registration goal, source, participant needs, and requested outcome

fields.label: Goal, source, participant needs, and requested outcome

blocks.label: Registration boundary
blocks.guidance: This form records childcare registration and operations; it does not decide legal custody, diagnose a child, prescribe care, grant blanket consent, or replace emergency services. Stop enrollment, activity, or release when identity, guardian direction, authorized pickup, health support, or safety is unresolved. Limit sensitive information to the approved record and route decisions to qualified authorized staff.

sections.title: Childcare contacts, release route, and support readiness
sections.guidance: Route sensitive health and support information to its approved record and reviewer.

blocks.label: Registration readiness and stop conditions
items: Guardian or emergency contact route is incomplete
Requested schedule or room placement is unavailable
Authorized pickup information is unclear or disputed
Required health, allergy, medication, or support review is pending
Child arrives before enrollment or start approval is complete
Release restriction or confidential record needs authorized review
Child becomes ill, injured, missing, or in immediate distress
Enrollment, attendance, billing, or record identity does not reconcile

blocks.label: Support or record source, applicability, owner, and status
Minimum-necessary information, access limits, assumptions, and open questions

fields.label: Information boundary, access limits, assumptions, and open questions

sections.title: Childcare placement, readiness, and authorization decision
sections.guidance: Separate requested placement from authorized placement and retained conditions.

blocks.label: Childcare readiness evidence
items: Enrollment record is tied to one child and program
Guardian and alternate contact routes are current
Requested days, hours, and start date are recorded
Authorized pickup list and release verification method are routed
Emergency contact and response information is available
Allergy, meal, medication, and health-plan references are routed privately
Accessibility, communication, developmental, or behavioral supports are routed
Custody or release restrictions are reviewed only by authorized staff
Orientation, supplies, and daily transition plan are scheduled
Open enrollment conditions have owners and due points

blocks.label: Requested element, review result, condition, owner, and evidence
Childcare registration decision
blocks.guidance: Record the authorized decision under current policy; this form does not grant authority to the preparer. Route uncertainty to the childcare administrator, guardian, and qualified health or support reviewer.

blocks.label: Placement rationale, alternatives, limits, and participant or guardian communication

sections.title: Childcare onboarding, exceptions, and first-day handoff
sections.guidance: Turn each unresolved condition into an owned action before participation begins.

blocks.label: Registration exception indicators
items: Enrollment or placement cannot proceed as requested
Guardian, emergency contact, or release route is incomplete
Required health, allergy, medication, or support review is pending
Child is present while enrollment authority remains unclear
Immediate illness, injury, missing-child, or safety response is active
Daily release, attendance, or onboarding closeout is unresolved

blocks.label: Condition, required action, owner, due point, and acceptance
Onboarding and first-day handoff
items: Authorized assignment and schedule communicated
Arrival, attendance, and departure routes visible
Guardian and emergency communication routes available
Approved health and support records routed privately
Open condition has an owner and due point
First review date and completion evidence identified

sections.title: Childcare outcome, closeout, and accountable handoff
sections.guidance: Make the final outcome, remaining limitation, next action, owner, and recipient visible.

blocks.label: Childcare closeout controls
items: Enrollment or daily status accepted by assigned staff
Guardian communication and next action recorded
Authorized pickup and emergency routes are available
Private health and support records are in approved custody
Open onboarding item has an owner and due point
Childcare record stored with access and retention requirements
blocks.guidance: Check only completed controls; preserve unresolved work as an open action.

blocks.label: Outcome verification, recipient acceptance, and reopen decision
Remaining limitation, action, owner, due point, and recipient route
blocks.guidance: Keep unresolved work visible until an accountable recipient accepts it.

blocks.label: Unresolved work, child or participant impact, evidence location, and handoff message

fields.label: Unresolved work, impact, evidence location, and handoff message

blocks.label: Registration closeout acknowledgment
blocks.guidance: Acknowledgment records preparation and receipt; it is not legal consent, medical certification, or professional approval.
